name: Multiple View Stereo Benchmark for Satellite Imagery
description: A benchmark dataset and evaluation framework for multiple-view stereo reconstruction using satellite imagery.
reputation: A well-targeted benchmark within the remote-sensing and photogrammetry communities but less widely used than terrestrial MVS benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; requires accurate sensor models and georeferencing; results sensitive to radiometry, baselines, and DEM postprocessing; dataset size and site diversity can limit generalization.
